title: The cheaper loan that costs R18,800 more #Debt
text:
Thabo (an illustration) owes R60,000 across four accounts and takes one consolidation loan at 24% a year. Over three years he pays about R2,354 a month; over five years only about R1,726 a month. The five-year loan looks cheaper, but over five years he pays back about R103,600, against about R84,700 over three years. The lower monthly payment costs him about R18,800 more.

About the example: R60,000 at 24% a year, standard loan (annuity) maths. Your own rate, fees and term will differ.

Full guide: "Debt Review vs Debt Consolidation vs Debt Counselling: Which One Fits You? (South Africa 2026)" comes out on Monday 23 November on the Money From Zero channel.
